title: GNNBleed: Inference Attacks to Unveil Private Edges in Graphs with Realistic Access to GNN Models
abstract: arXiv:2311.16139v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have become indispensable tools for learning from graph structured data, catering to various applications such as social network analysis and fraud detection for financial services. At the heart of these networks are the edges, which are crucial in guiding GNN models' predictions. In many scenarios, these edges represent sensitive information, such as personal associations or financial dealings, which require privacy assurance. However, their contributions to GNN model predictions may, in turn, be exploited by the adversary to compromise their privacy. translated_title: GNNBleed：在真实访问GNN模型条件下揭示图中私有边的推断攻击
translated_abstract: 图神经网络（GNNs）已成为从图结构数据中学习不可或缺的工具，适用于社交网络分析和金融服务欺诈检测等各种应用。这些网络的核心是边，它们在引导GNN模型的预测中至关重要。在许多场景中，这些边代表敏感信息，如个人关联或金融交易，需要隐私保障。然而，它们对GNN模型预测的贡献可能反过来被对手利用以破坏其隐私。受这些冲突需求的驱动，本文研究了对手仅能对目标GNN模型进行黑盒访问、且受访问控制进一步限制、无法直接洞察任意节点输出的情境下的边隐私。此外，我们是首次广泛考察目标图持续变化的情况。
tldr: 本文首次提出GNNBleed攻击，在对手仅具受限黑盒访问权限且目标图动态变化的情况下，通过推断揭示图中私有边，从而突破GNN模型的边隐私保护。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GNNBleed, the first attack that unveils private edges in graphs under restricted black-box access to GNN models and dynamically evolving target graphs, thereby compromising edge privacy.
